question.text: 'Global Macro' strategy makes investment decisions based on:

answer.text: Top-down analysis of currencies, interest rates, commodities, and macroeconomic trends

explanation.text: The Logic: Global macro uses top-down macroeconomic analysis to take currency/rate/commodity positions. The Trap: Bottom-up/single-stock focus is different. Cross-Exam Context: Important Cat III strategy category. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Global macro funds can have large swings — right for diversification, wrong as a core holding.
